content: {"action":"upsert_decision_section","body":"The backup-plant observation GRD-071 at v8 reports 29.8 megawatts as current [GRID]. This is a reserve figure, not a verified flow against emergency cooling load; the distinction between installed capacity and usable capacity under surge must be maintained [GRID]. The blocking voltage-window finding in REVIEW remains open: until the third voltage window is confirmed within tolerance, the 29.8 MW reserve cannot be treated as dispatchable for continuity operations [REVIEW]. Water pressure at the mobile-cache WTR-071 v8 reads 39.8 psi, current [WATER]. This is a reserve-pressure observation, not a sustained flow measurement; hydration logistics require that flow rate, not static pressure, be verified against demand [WATER]. The third pressure-window blocking finding in REVIEW remains open and must be closed before water continuity can be declared ready [REVIEW]. Falsifier: if either the voltage or pressure window exceeds tolerance on re-measurement, the corresponding reserve figure is invalid for continuity planning [GRID][WATER][REVIEW]. Rollback: reverting to pre-surge allocation requires that both grid and water reserves return to baseline within their respective tolerance windows, confirmed by current-status observation [GRID][WATER].","heading":"Power, water, and cooling continuity"}
